# Council for Exceptional Children

> The premier international professional organization dedicated to improving educational outcomes for students with disabilities and exceptional learners through advocacy, professional development, and evidence-based special education practices.

CEC serves special education professionals including teachers, paraeducators, administrators, and related service providers. The organization provides comprehensive resources including professional development through the CEC Learning Library, peer-reviewed publications like TEACHING Exceptional Children, membership benefits, and topical guidance on critical areas such as autism, learning disabilities, STEM instruction, and IDEA compliance.

## Key Topics

- Council for Exceptional Children (CEC)
- Special Education
- IDEA Compliance

## Professional Development & Learning

- [CEC Learning Library](https://exceptionalchildren.org/learninglibrary): On-demand webinars, courses, and continuing education for special educators
- [Store](https://exceptionalchildren.org/store): CEC publications, books, journals, and curated special education resources
- [Special Education TODAY Blog](https://exceptionalchildren.org/blog): Weekly special education news, policy updates, and CEC announcements

## Membership & Account Management

- [Individual Membership](https://exceptionalchildren.org/membership/individual-membership): CEC membership categories, pricing, and professional educator registration
- [Account Management](https://exceptionalchildren.org/account): Member login and account management for CEC resources and benefits

## Special Education Topics & Guidance

- [All Topics Directory](https://exceptionalchildren.org/topics): Directory of special education topics, standards, and educator resources
- [Specially Designed Instruction](https://exceptionalchildren.org/topics/specially-designed-instruction): SDI, IEP goals, and IDEA-compliant instruction guidance for special educators
- [Autism](https://exceptionalchildren.org/topics/autism): Autism spectrum disorder information, teaching strategies, and evidence practices
- [Learning Disabilities](https://exceptionalchildren.org/topics/learning-disabilities): Learning disabilities overview, dyslexia, assistive technology, and resources
- [STEM Instruction](https://exceptionalchildren.org/topics/stem-instruction): STEM teaching strategies and supports for students with disabilities
- [Working with Families](https://exceptionalchildren.org/topics/working-families): Family-professional partnerships, IEP collaboration, and parent involvement
- [Student Engagement](https://exceptionalchildren.org/topics/student-engagement): Student engagement strategies, positive relationships, and classroom techniques
- [Maltreatment & Bullying Prevention](https://exceptionalchildren.org/topics/maltreatment-bullying): Maltreatment prevention, bullying awareness, and CEC Bright Spot Project

## Paraeducator Resources

- [Paraeducators](https://exceptionalchildren.org/paraeducators): CEC paraeducator resources, academy, and competencies framework

## Support & Engagement
